Skills are reusable instructions and workflows for Claude Code or other agent systems. They help an agent repeat a trading task reliably, such as researching a stock, checking options, backtesting a strategy, or managing a portfolio. When a Skill is designed to work with a listed MCP, the entry shows .

We welcome community contributions: new entries, removal of dead links, and discussion on sub-category boundaries. Start with CONTRIBUTING.md (or CONTRIBUTING.zh-CN.md in Chinese); the guide puts the AI-native review path, quality bar, submission format, check, and bilingual-PR rule in one place. New entries are smoothest via the Issue: add entry template; removals via the Issue: remove entry template.
